answer: For epoch 124 the yard tags each timber lot with one split cipher and posts the retained half on the public board. Each key posts a 15 POA bond and tenders the held half at the harbor gate. The board stores one redemption per lot; a second tender, a half that fails to match the posted half, or a cipher already redeemed at the harbor burns the 15 POA bond. A farm of 370 keys that can mill only ten timber lots can redeem only ten halves, so 360 keys each burn 15 POA: 360 x 15 = 5,400 POA the attacker forfeits.
